weights: Raw epoch200 model weights, native training input coordinates

gain: ||W_in u_i||^2 for actual unit input direction; shares normalized by all768 gains
alignment: Squared overlaps of top64 input directions and native W_in Gram eigenvectors; x=input, y=Gram, rank1 lower left
